meta.title: Pricing — Starter, Pro and Studio
meta.description: Compare AI generations, storage, members and API access. Starter is free; Pro and Studio add higher quotas and team capabilities.
meta.ogDescription: Start free, then add generations, storage and team capabilities as you publish more.
meta.jsonLdDescription: Generate thumbnails, scripts, sound effects and images for video creators in one project workspace.

page.title: Pricing that stays honest about limits
page.description: Every quota and capability below is enforced by the product. Start free, then move up when your publishing schedule needs it.
page.billingNote: All paid plans are billed monthly in USD. Prices exclude any taxes that may apply.

compare.title: Compare every limit
compare.description: Quotas reset each billing period for paid plans and each calendar month for Starter.
compare.caption: Feature and quota comparison for Starter, Pro and Studio

try.question: Do I need a plan to try the product?
try.answer: No. Starter is free, needs no card, and includes {count} AI generations every month.

quota.question: What happens when I reach a quota?
quota.answer: Generation for that feature stops until the quota resets or you upgrade. Your existing projects and assets stay available.

cancel.question: Can I cancel?
cancel.answer: Yes. Use Manage subscription to cancel in the Stripe Customer Portal. You keep the paid plan until the end of the period you have already paid for.

refunds.question: How do refunds work?
refunds.answer: The Customer Portal does not issue refunds. Contact support and we will review the request against the payment record.

annual.question: Do you offer annual billing?
annual.answer: Not yet. Every paid plan is billed monthly.

chooser.title: Change plan
chooser.description: Upgrades start in Stripe Checkout. Downgrades and cancellation happen in the Customer Portal, so nothing changes without your confirmation.
chooser.downgradeNotice: Downgrades take effect at the end of the current billing period{date}. You keep {plan} until then; after that the lower plan's generation, storage and member limits apply.
chooser.manualPlan: This plan was granted manually. Support manages changes to it.
